articles.title: After Patriots coaching stint, DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech staff
articles.description:
Hopkins had recently dipped his toe into coaching during Patriots training camp.

articles.title: Could Efton Chism and Kyle Williams both make the Patriots 53-man roster?
articles.description:
The pair of second-year wide receivers each had eye-popping touchdown grabs during the Patriots' red zone period Friday.

summary: Efton Chism and Kyle Williams showcased impressive touchdown catches during practice on July 31.

articles.title: Reports: OF George Springer interested in trade to Red Sox, team eyeing INF Xavier Edwards
articles.description:
Springer, currently with the Blue Jays, has an eight-team no-trade list, but apparently wouldn’t block a deal to Boston.

The post Reports: OF George Springer interested in trade to Red Sox, team eyeing INF Xavier Edwards appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: George Springer, Blue Jays outfielder, may accept a trade to the Red Sox.
Springer has an eight-team no-trade list but is open to Boston.
Red Sox are also considering INF Xavier Edwards to strengthen their roster.

articles.title: Mass. close to giving doctors final word on late abortions
articles.description:
Opponents say that it would allow abortion until birth — even on healthy fetuses — and that later abortions are more complex and risky for the women.

The post Mass. close to giving doctors final word on late abortions appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Massachusetts lawmakers are nearing a decision on allowing doctors to determine late abortion eligibility.
Opponents argue this could permit abortions until birth, even for healthy fetuses.
The change may increase risks for women undergoing complex late-term abortion procedures.
